name: Edogawa Jun
source:
[url=/c65379]Ubuse Shinobu[/url]'s younger sister. That is, Chiharu's aunt. A cool-type beauty with wavy long hair. She works as an insurance sales representative.

Her husband has been out on a tuna fishing boat for offshore fishing for about half a year now, trying to repay a large, risky debt.

She's bursting with pent-up sexual energy from her ripe body, but she vents her daily desires by speeding around in her husband's car, an RX-8. She has a bit of a speed freak streak.

She belonged to the track team in her student days, so unlike her sister, she's athletically gifted. She also has a six-month-old infant.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080922232536/http://www.lucha-game.com/product/mama/chara.html] archived official site[/url]]
